state.task: Reply to a customer of a weekly meal-kit delivery service.
state.input: I want to skip next week's box. Today is Monday.
state.reply_a: Done: next week's box is skipped at no charge. Your deliveries carry on the week after.
state.reply_b: You can skip boxes in the app. Let us know if you have other questions.
rules: A missing or damaged box reported within 48 hours of delivery gets a full credit or a free replacement box, the customer's pick.
A missing or damaged box reported later than 48 hours after delivery gets a 50% credit.
Credits and replacement boxes are the only remedies; never refund money to the card.
Skipping or pausing a week is free when done before Wednesday 23:59 for the next week's box.
Never ask the customer for a password, a full card number or a card security code.
Do not promise a delivery hour; give the delivery day and the 8:00-20:00 window.

better_reply.instructions: Which reply would serve the customer in state.input better, given state.rules?

criteria.neither: Both serve the customer equally well or equally badly
